observations: White Xbox One X console with a perforated top panel.
The console has a matte white finish and a black base.
The controller has a matte white finish with black buttons and a black center button.
The console is shown from the front and side in all photos.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'FRANKLIN VENTURES' are visible on all photos.

claims.evidence: The photos do not show the console's internal storage or the game library.
No video or audio output is shown; the console is not powered on.
The internal hardware and software state cannot be confirmed from still photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and a game launching.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty or unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game loading.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the Xbox Live service.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the internet and signing into a Microsoft account.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.
Photo of the console's model number sticker (usually on the back or bottom).
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a white Xbox One X console. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working) until proof of functionality is provided.
